title: A/R Collection: the PDF and CSV carry the phone and credit term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has two overdue invoices, a phone number and a credit term.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-03 Export Call with phone (403) 555-0102 and credit term Net 15.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with only {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Read {Customer-A}'s line in the PDF.
  3. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  4. Read the CSV heading row.
  5. Read both of {Customer-A}'s rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the PDF downloads.
  • Step 2: the same phone and credit term as on screen, on the customer's line.
  • Step 3: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 4: "Phone" and "Credit term" columns come right after "Customer".
  • Step 5: every row carries {Customer-A}'s phone and credit term.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S9-R3: “The PDF prints the same phone and credit term on each customer's line; the CSV carries them in columns (S3-R8a).”
  • S3-R8a: “On A/R Collection, every CSV row also carries the customer's "Phone" and, for users with 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Credit term", in columns right after "Customer"; the PDF prints them on each customer's line (Story 9).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-call-list-on-a-r-collection.png: figure "Call list on A/R Collection" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p2-export-menu-pdf-and-csv.png: figure "Export menu: PDF and CSV" (This build (after)), board "2. Export"

The design's own words:

  • "Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a." (caption of "Call list on A/R Collection")
  • "The native ⋯ Export menu on all six reports. Files hold exactly the rows on screen, in screen order, with the as-of date and locations, then Past due and the customer or vendor when chosen. S3-R1 to S3-R8, S3-R8a." (caption of "Export menu: PDF and CSV")
